✦ Know the founder

This is Sreelaxmi Nair.

hi, I'm Sree ✦

Somewhere between a camera, a notebook, a ridiculous number of ideas and an unhealthy curiosity about why people do what they do, you’ll probably find Sree (yes, that’s how we lovingly call her).

Sree is the founder of Chimes Media, a creative studio built around one rather simple idea: good stories deserve to be told well.

With a background in journalism and a brain that refuses to stay in just one creative lane, Sree has spent years moving between storytelling, filmmaking, photography, design, content strategy and social media. She can be found writing a strategy one minute, directing a shoot the next, and obsessing over a font choice five minutes later.

She likes ideas with personality. Brands with something to say. Films that leave you thinking about them days later. Visuals that make you stop scrolling. And conversations that somehow turn into three new ideas.

That same obsession with stories eventually found its way into the world of brands — and Chimes Media Social, the social-first sister company of Chimes Media, was born.

At Chimes Media Social, Sree brings strategy, storytelling and creativity to the world of social media — helping brands figure out not just what to post, but why they should be saying it in the first place.

Because she doesn't believe in making things just because “we need to post today.”

She believes brands are more interesting when they behave like people — when they have a voice, a point of view, quirks, stories and something worth saying.

So, she built a place where those things could exist.

Chimes Media Social is her little corner of the creative universe — where strategy meets storytelling, ideas get a little louder, and brands get to sound like themselves.

And she's only getting started.
